Scanora One

Scan what you have. Create what you need.

Scanora One turns receipts, notes, forms, certificates and bills into clean digital documents, and creates QR codes for links, contacts, Wi-Fi and more. Everything you scan or create is kept in a searchable history.

Download on theApp StoreVisit the Scanora One website (opens in a new tab)
Category
Utilities
Platforms
iPhone

What Scanora One does

  • Document scanning

    Auto-crop, perspective correction and text extraction (OCR) for receipts, notes, forms and bills.

  • QR code creator

    Eleven code types including URL, contact, Wi-Fi, email, SMS, location, phone and calendar event.

  • Dashboard

    Totals, categories and quick actions for everything you have scanned and created.

  • History

    Search and filter past scans and codes.
